extras: Pro features require GitHub sponsorship. The free version includes basic board display, lane picking, and check-off functionality.
problem: Users need a way to view and interact with a structured Kanban board within the context of a specific note without relying on external views or plugins.

relations.evidence: Kanban Embed hands the card line to Tasks, so recurring tasks and the date format follow your settings.

summary: Kanban Embed displays a dynamic Kanban board visualization directly inside any Obsidian note, allowing live updates, lane picking, and card manipulation.
